overview_description.description:
Proof Trading is an institutional equities broker that aims to get investors better prices. Finance is a bloated industry. It is opaque and old-fashioned, and it has not substantially improved through the technological revolution in the way other industries have, in part because there are tremendous barriers to entry for new innovative players.

Proof Trading was founded in 2019 and is based in New York, New York.

product.name: Proof Algo
product.description: A hybrid liquidity seeker and impact minimization algorithm that balances execution speed with minimizing market impact, including a component that searches for block liquidity.

product.name: VWAP Algo
product.description: An algorithm that trades in line with market volume using a dynamic volume prediction model.

product.name: Aggressive Algo
product.description: An aggressive liquidity-seeking algorithm that uses dynamic volume prediction and targets a specific participation rate.

product.name: Close Algo
product.description: An algorithm targeting the closing auction price while minimizing market impact using a dynamic intraday model predicting auction size.
